items.title: Show HN: An agent skill that optimizes code with falsifiable hypotheses
items.why: It combines core Computer Science algorithm concepts with AI agents to automatically improve code efficiency.
items.summary: Created by an algorithm engineering professor, this agent tool uses scientific hypothesis testing to systematically benchmark and optimize code performance.

items.title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
items.why: It shows a practical, real-world way to use AI agents to speed up Python code without rewriting your entire codebase.
items.summary: Fast-Anything profiles your Python app to find slow functions and uses an AI coding agent to rewrite only those parts in high-performance Rust.

items.title: qianyiai/kurocat
items.why: It is a fun open-source project demonstrating how to use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in desktop AI tools.
items.summary: KuroCat is an open-source desktop cat animation and AI coding companion that connects with LLMs like Claude and DeepSeek using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

items.title: danielwh2/sprite-stacking
items.why: It demonstrates how custom agent skills can expand the capabilities of coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor.
items.summary: Sprite Stacking is an AI agent plugin that turns 2D pixel art views into rotatable pseudo-3D graphics for game projects.

items.title: xikhar/papercraft
items.why: It is a practical example of extending AI coding agents to produce specialized creative web layouts.
items.summary: Papercraft is an agent plugin that enables AI tools to build interactive web pages and animations styled like handcrafted pop-up paper art.

items.title: sous-labs/songe
items.why: It offers an approachable open-source tool if you want to experiment with fine-tuning AI models locally.
items.summary: Songe is an open-source training engine designed to fine-tune local machine learning models by using spare compute resources on your machine.

items.title: Porting Rockbox to an undocumented $9 AliExpress 'YP3' MP3 player with LLMs
items.why: It highlights a practical story of using LLMs to assist with low-level software engineering and reverse engineering.
items.summary: A developer documented how they used LLMs to help write drivers and port open-source music player software to a cheap, undocumented MP3 player.

items.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei denies wanting humanity to ‘surrender’ free will to AI
items.why: It keeps you informed on key industry debates regarding AI safety and ethics from leading AI company founders.
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly addressed concerns about advanced AI, denying claims that humanity would have to cede decision-making power to AI systems.

items.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
items.why: It shows how market sentiment around AI infrastructure investment is affecting the broader tech economy.
items.summary: US stock markets saw tech indices like the Nasdaq drop nearly 4 percent as market concerns mounted over AI development spending and returns.

items.title: Launch HN: Versine (YC F26) – MCP to send and receive money
items.why: It introduces a startup building financial infrastructure specifically designed for AI agents.
items.summary: Versine is a Y Combinator startup using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow autonomous AI agents to request and transfer funds.

items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.why: It is important cybersecurity news affecting developer tools and security practices.
items.summary: 1Password reported a security incident, prompting developers and cybersecurity teams to review their access security practices.

items.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
items.why: It covers a significant global political development regarding the legal proceedings of a world leader.
items.summary: Israeli judges formally advised prosecutors to drop the most serious corruption charges against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu due to insufficient evidence.

items.title: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
items.why: It delivers an update on major developments in ongoing global conflicts.
items.summary: Ukrainian military forces reported striking an airbase in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region, damaging multiple military aircraft.

items.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
items.why: It covers a major international news event regarding a fatal infrastructure accident.
items.summary: A fuel tanker overturn and explosion on a busy highway in Cairo, Egypt resulted in at least 31 deaths and over 20 injuries.
